import sys
import math

def ms(s, n):
    for i in range(len(s)):
        s[i] = n

def FOR(i, a, b):
    return range(a, b)

def FORd(i, a, b):
    return range(a - 1, b - 1, -1)

def sz(a):
    return len(a)

def all(a):
    return a

def pb(a, x):
    a.append(x)

def mp(a, b):
    return (a, b)

def fi(pair):
    return pair[0]

def se(pair):
    return pair[1]

def bitcount(x):
    return bin(x).count('1')

def perform_transform(a, n, p, invert):
    logn = n.bit_length() - 1
    for i in range(logn):
        for mask in range(n):
            if mask & (1 << i):
                prev = mask ^ (1 << i)
                if not invert:
                    a[mask] = (a[mask] + a[prev]) % p
                else:
                    a[mask] = (a[mask] - a[prev] + p) % p

def power_convolution(a, k, p):
    n = len(a)
    if k == 1:
        return a
    if k % 2 == 1:
        temp = power_convolution(a, k - 1, p)
        res = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n - i):
                res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + temp[i] * a[j]) % p
        return res
    else:
        half = power_convolution(a, k // 2, p)
        res = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n - i):
                res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + half[i] * half[j]) % p
        return res

def subset_power_convolution(a, k, p):
    LOGN = 19
    n = len(a)
    while n & (n - 1):
        n += 1
    fa = [[0] * n for _ in range(LOGN)]
    fc = [[0] * n for _ in range(LOGN)]
    for i in range(LOGN):
        for j in range(n):
            if bitcount(j) == i and j < len(a):
                fa[i][j] = a[j]
            else:
                fa[i][j] = 0
            fc[i][j] = 0
        perform_transform(fa[i], n, p, False)
    for i in range(n):
        v = [fa[j][i] for j in range(LOGN)]
        v = power_convolution(v, k, p)
        for j in range(LOGN):
            fc[j][i] = v[j]
    for i in range(LOGN):
        perform_transform(fc[i], n, p, True)
        for j in range(n):
            if bitcount(j) == i and j < len(a):
                a[j] = fc[i][j]
    return a

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n, k, p = map(int, input[:3])
    data = list(map(int, input[3:]))

    tempN = n
    maskVal = 0
    for i in range(20):
        if (n >> i) & 1:
            maskVal |= (1 << i)

    f = [0] * (maskVal + 1)
    for i in range(maskVal + 1):
        t = 0
        for j in range(20):
            if (n >> j) & 1:
                t <<= 1
                t |= (i >> j) & 1
        f[t] = i

    if n & 1:
        print(pow(k, n, p))
        return

    MAXN = 10**6 + 5
    fac = [1] * MAXN
    invFac = [1] * MAXN

    for i in range(1, MAXN):
        fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % p

    invFac[MAXN - 1] = pow(fac[MAXN - 1], p - 2, p)
    for i in range(MAXN - 2, -1, -1):
        invFac[i] = (invFac[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % p

    a = [0] * (maskVal + 1)
    for i in range(maskVal + 1):
        a[i] = invFac[f[i]]

    res = pow(k, n, p)
    a = subset_power_convolution(a, k, p)
    subtractVal = (a[maskVal] * fac[n]) % p
    res = (res - subtractVal + p) % p
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
